# Swap WETH

> Swap WETH by unwrapping Wrapped Ether to ETH 1:1 or trading it for another token on a DEX.

## Key facts
- Token: WETH (Wrapped Ether), an ERC-20 representation of ETH
- Contract: 0xC02aaA39b223FE8D0A0e5C4F27eAD9083C756Cc2 (Ethereum)
- Wrap / unwrap: 1:1 with ETH, gas only
- DEX swap: pool fee + gas + price impact
- Standard: ERC-20
- Verify: Check the contract address, not the ticker
